answer: Make new agents earn through a narrow inlet. Every fresh identity's rewards drip into a marble escrow that opens only after it has graded 30 peers picked by a seed nobody controls. A lotus pond of sybils still has to do that honest grading once per head, and any clone whose verdicts move in step with its siblings gets flagged and its escrow burned. The attacker pays real compute and weeks of locked capital for every fake, with nothing liquid until each one proves independent judgment.
